outline: This course aims to teach students the fundamental knowledge of ceramic materials. It will start from the introduction of ceramic materials including bonding, structure, and defects. Afterward, important properties of ceramics including electrical, dielectric, magnetic, and optical properties will be discussed.
schedule:
1. Bonding and structure of ceramics (3 weeks)
2. Defects in ceramics (3 weeks)
3. Mass and electrical transport in ceramics (3 weeks)
4. Electrical, magnetic, and optical properties of ceramics (4 weeks)
5. Introduction to oxide glasses (optional, 2 weeks)
